headline: TikTok bans Musk documentary account
summary: TikTok has banned the social media account for Alex Gibney's upcoming Musk documentary. The ban occurred just ahead of the film's wider release. Distributor Bleecker Street confirmed a 'permanent suspension' was imminent.

headline: Mercedes-AMG’s first ground-up SUV is a 1,150hp electric beast
summary: Mercedes-AMG has unveiled its first dedicated electric SUV, the 2028 GT SUV. The vehicle boasts over 1,150 horsepower from three axial flux motors. It promises ultra-fast charging and high performance.

headline: Elon Musk settles lawsuits over $1 million voter giveaway
summary: Elon Musk has agreed to settle two lawsuits concerning his 2024 $1 million voter giveaway. He had promised daily giveaways to registered voters in swing states. The lottery had faced legal challenges and fraud claims from Arizona residents.

headline: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
summary: Meta is updating its terms to remove language that suggested it could scrape content, including from news sites. The removed clause allowed Meta to use content from various domains to train its AI. This change comes after significant backlash.

headline: Dev Behind Russian Roulette Drinking Game Cancels Steam Demo Plans Following AI Copycat Concerns
summary: The developer of 'Drunken Goddess Reflux,' a Russian roulette anime game, has canceled its Steam demo. The decision was made due to concerns over potential AI copycat games. The developer fears AI tools could easily replicate their concept.

headline: Battlefield 6 Devs Respond After Players Take Aim at 'Secuty' Typo and Cosmetic With 5 Pistols
summary: Battlefield 6 developers have responded to player complaints about new Season 5 cosmetics. Fans criticized a 'Secuty' typo and a cosmetic featuring five pistols. The team addressed the community backlash regarding these controversial additions.

headline: James Cameron Congratulates Marvel After Avengers: Endgame Beats Avatar at the Box Office Yet Again
summary: James Cameron congratulated Marvel after 'Avengers: Endgame' surpassed 'Avatar' at the box office once more. The two films have repeatedly traded places for the top-grossing movie worldwide. Cameron acknowledged the milestone with a social media post.

headline: Ben Affleck's Batman Movie Would Have Featured Arkham Asylum-Inspired Deathstroke Fight and DCEU Batgirl, Joe Manganiello Reveals
summary: Joe Manganiello has revealed new plot details about Ben Affleck's canceled Batman film. The movie would have included an Arkham Asylum-inspired fight with Deathstroke. DCEU Batgirl was also planned to be featured in the unmade project.

headline: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as more than 1,200 arrested after protests
summary: Widespread disorder, looting, and fires erupted in cities across France. Over 1,200 people were arrested amidst nationwide protests. The unrest followed cost of living protests joined by over half a million people.

headline: Watch: Moment historic French town hall spire collapses in flames amid protests
summary: An historic town hall in Limoges, France, was set ablaze during national protests. Footage captured the dramatic collapse of the building's spire in flames. The incident highlights the intensity of the ongoing unrest across France.

headline: Several dead or injured in major fire at Canada military base
summary: A major fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright has resulted in several deaths or injuries. Officials are withholding specific details, calling the situation 'very active and delicate.' The cause and exact casualty count have not yet been released.

headline: A wave of homemade, synthetic drugs sweeps US and deepens crisis
summary: The US is facing a new drug epidemic driven by homemade, synthetic substances. BBC News investigates the crisis, speaking with users, dealers, and recovery workers. The surge in these dangerous drugs is deepening the country's addiction challenges.
